mission.title: Find and Interact with Yara
mission.objective: Complete the full experience of entering the world, exploring your surroundings, locating Yara, and engaging in a conversation to see the outcome.
mission.instructions: 1. Enter the world. 2. Explore the environment. 3. Locate Yara. 4. Initiate an interaction with Yara. 5. Observe and experience the outcome of that interaction. In your report, describe your experience in your own words, specifically noting the response you received from Yara.
criteria: The user arrives in the world, the user explores the world, the user locates yara within the world and the user initiates an interaction with yara — reaching "Yara." in the product's main experience
The user experiences the outcome of interacting with yara — a NEW result from "Yara." that was not on screen beforehand
evidenceList: Describe how you reached "Yara." and what you saw when it opened (name the screen you came from).
Say exactly what you did to "Yara.", and describe what appeared as a result — it must be something that was not on screen before.
